title: Severity Archery
blurb: Every bug report is an arrow: the bullseye is its right severity, and each ring out is one level off, under-rated on the left and over-rated on the right.
lesson: With a clear sentence for each level, a Score lands bugs on the right severity, and a near miss is far less costly than a wild one.
why: Severity is ordered, from Trivial to Critical, so it is a Score question with five levels, each described in one sentence. Jev returns the level as a number with a probability for every level, so its arrows can land between rings.
Being one level off and being four levels off are very different mistakes. The target shows which way each racer missed, so you can see if it tends to under-rate or over-rate.
